'''Team OK-UK''' was a travel and friend group of United Kingdom Star Wars CCG players at [[DecipherCon 2000]]. Alan Rimmel made shirts for the group. The back read "DecipherCon 2k - Came to drink."<ref name="tennet">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-13-deciphercon-2000-juz-beer-and-cardsd1338/ deciphercon-2000-juz-beer-and-cards], Alex "Greedo" Tennet, Decktech (13 October 2000)</ref>

Tennet's props list the UK crew around him that weekend, including [[Peter DiBiasio]] (undefeated Day 1 Swiss winner), [[Gary Carman]], Bruce Savin, Ian Ericson, Mat Allen, Dave / Billy / Thomas Crane, Adrian Selwood, Rob Bowles, and Derek Hawkesworth. That is a convention travel list, not a published long-running constructed roster.
